64bit.pre_install: if (-not (is_admin)) { abort "`n[ERROR]  $app requires admin rights to $cmd." }

arm64.pre_install: if (-not (is_admin)) { abort "`n[ERROR]  $app requires admin rights to $cmd." }

script: if (-not $extract_status) { abort "`nExtraction Failed: Unable to unpack '$dir\setup.exe'." }
if (-not $installer_file) { abort "`nDeployment Failed: MSI package not found in extraction buffer." }
abort "Installation Failed: Exit code indicates a deployment failure.`nReference Log: '$dir\tmp\install.log'."
if (-not $license_file) { abort "`nDeployment Failed: License not found in extraction buffer." }
if (-not $extension_status) { abort "Installation Failed: Process did not complete.`nReference Log: '$dir\tmp\install-extension.log'." }
if (-not $extension_status) { abort 'Uninstallation Failed: Oracle VirtualBox Extension Pack uninstallation was not successful.' }
if (-not $product_id) { abort "Uninstallation Failed: Could not locate the product identity for Oracle VirtualBox." }
if(-not $removal_status) { abort "Uninstallation Failed: Process did not complete.`nReference Log: '$dir\uninstall.log'." }

postInstall: if (-not (Test-Path -Path "$install_dir\*")) { abort "`nInstallation Failed: The directory '$install_dir' is missing or empty." }
notes: The VirtualBox Extension Pack is free only for personal, educational, or evaluation use.
Enterprise use requires the purchase of a valid commercial license.
For detailed licensing information, refer to: https://www.virtualbox.org/wiki/Licensing_FAQ.
